hints.hint: 先确定一条门槛，再逐项看它够不够格。

for i in range(len(names)): 下一行缩进写 if values[i] >= 3: picked.append(names[i])。

solution:
names = ["雪山日出", "蓝色机器人", "校园漫画", "太空猫咪"]
values = [4, 2, 5, 3]
threshold = 3

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
